description: Sabotages for win-debugging-sys. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1; see tools/README-sabotage.md for the format and for why the results are read the way they are.
notCoveredHere: A string sent to the call with its terminator missing, or with a NUL before it, is not injected: the call would read past the buffer, and the sweep would be measuring a crash and not a test. The refusal and the terminator are each checked on the built string, in memory, and the call is checked by a debugger receiving what it sent (WD-D-2).

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: the terminator is added twice
sabotages.why: The built string is the units and one terminator. A second changes what is sent and is seen by every test of the built string; a missing one is the sabotage that is not injected, see notCoveredHere.

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: a NUL in the string is not looked for
sabotages.why: A NUL in the units would end the string the call reads at that unit, and show only what came before. The refusal is what stops a string being cut without the caller being told.

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: the refusal names the unit after the NUL
sabotages.why: The index is where the first NUL is, in units, so a caller can find it; one more points at the wrong unit.

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: the refusal names the last NUL and not the first
sabotages.why: The first NUL is where the call would end the string, and the one a caller meets first.
find: if let Some(index) = units.iter().position(|&unit| unit == NUL) {
replace: if let Some(index) = units.iter().rposition(|&unit| unit == NUL) {

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: a str is sent as its first unit only
sabotages.why: A str is every unit it encodes to, so the NUL in one is found wherever it is.

sabotages.name: WD-D-2: the call is not made
sabotages.why: Only a debugger can tell that the call was made, which is why the test of it starts one: nothing in the process sees the difference.

sabotages.name: WD-D-3: every string is taken as ANSI
sabotages.why: Whether a string arrived as Unicode is what the opt-in of WaitForDebugEventEx changes, and the observation of it is the point of the facility.

sabotages.name: WD-D-3: the terminator is kept in a received string
sabotages.why: The length an event carries counts the terminator the call sends; a string is what comes before it, so an empty one is empty.

sabotages.name: WD-D-2 control: the NUL is looked for by its literal value
sabotages.why: A control: the same test by another spelling, which no test can tell apart. A sweep that reports it caught is reporting everything caught and proves nothing.
